extracted.name: Creamy cheese cake recipe with strawberry jam and chocolate🥰👌
extracted.description: A super simple and quick cake that you will love😍👍 Video Link: https://youtu.be/yBI1vYUVaR4 #cake #cheese #creamy #strawberry #jam #marmalade #chocolate #dessert #sweet #baked #oven #red #frosting #glaze
ingredient_lines: 1 kg soft cottage cheese (creamy curd cheese)
instruction_lines: We make a semi-soft dough from the listed ingredients, which we let stand for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix the cottage cheese, yogurt, sugar & pudding powder together until it gets smooth.
Roll out the rested dough slightly larger than the size of the baking sheet. Put the dough on a baking sheet with paper, prick it with a fork & evenly distribute the cheese filling.
Bake the cake in a preheated oven at 190 °C for about 20-25 minutes.
Spread a thick layer of jam on the cooled cake, then cover with chocolate frosting.

The cake tastes fantastic. It is creamy, fragile and thanks to the strawberry jam, it has a sour taste and is not too sweet at all 😊 It is also suitable for a visit, or for holidays or celebrations. Enjoy your meal❗
You can find more of my recipes on my blog cesminazuenal.blogspot.com and on my Youtube Channel @Cesminaz 🥰😋🧡
